Diagnosis: Conflicting position constraints: Both 'reach_distance' and 'freeze_position' were included, violating the operator usage rule that only ONE position operator ('reach_point', 'reach_distance', or 'freeze_position') may be present across all constraints. 'freeze_position' was inappropriately used to encode contact or movement stopping, but should only be used when explicit position freezing is required. Only 'reach_distance' is appropriate here for the approach/contact criterion.
Reasoning: The goal is to move the robot tool (panda_fingertip) so its origin reaches and establishes contact (effort/contact or within 1cm) with the center of the top_drawer_handle_frame, while keeping orientation fixed. Contact can be physical (manipulator_high_effort) or within 1cm (reach_distance), so 'or' logic is used between these two alternatives. Only one position operator is allowed, so we retain 'reach_distance' and do NOT use 'freeze_position'. The 'freeze_orientation' constraint is included with 'and' logic because orientation must remain fixed through the approach. The gripper must stay open, enforced with 'open_gripper' (and logic, as it is not part of the mutually exclusive contact condition).
